doc.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
doc.interviewee: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey

title: Opening Delcy's place; Peter Bocage and absent family
summary: Willie E. recalls opening the place with Chris Bond and Peter Bocage; talk turns to Peter's age, his son, and when Earl might visit.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Why so? Remember that little Jackson? Remember Peter Burkage?
Well, they still working there when I was working there with Albuquerque.
He's still over in Algiers. He still plays in the Eureka band with your son Percy quite often. Peter does.
Yeah, Pete told me he's 71 years old. I didn't know he was that. I didn't realize, I'll show you, I didn't realize he was that old.

Yeah, he does. But he looks it, he looks it now. Yeah, he looks it. He's his age. Five or six years, I think. That's where's his son over there, right, right there. Oh, that's the first son in the Unicorn, huh? Yeah, he's in the, he's in the, he's in the pharmacy, the pharmacy in the, in the army in Texas. I don't know.
Mm-hmm. Ain't more than a part of me, he's in the, part of the country, isn't he? Why?

Well, it was in Charlotteville, Virginia. Charlotteville, Virginia. Virginia, that's it. He just lost his wife here last week. Oh, oh, I didn't know she was there. Huh? No, it's just, nobody told me how I was there. No. Maybe she ain't, I don't know. Oh. I'm looking for him to be down here soon. When he going down to the country? You know, he gets, he gets, he gets drinking, he can say anything.
How he gets to drink, when did he ever stop? You think Earl might come over here from?
Well, I'm, I'm feeling he's going to be in here most of the time. I'd like to talk to him. He might come to you. He never met him.
And he'll come right here because he's at home, right?
Yes. That's the first one when I saw her, when he came over to the house in California, asked me about where the house is. Mm-hm.
